## From the Pacific Ocean to the high-altitude desert

Chile stretches along the Andes and the Pacific Ocean, so even a short route takes you through very different landscapes. You will first explore Santiago and the coastal cities, then fly north to the San Pedro de Atacama area.

The Atacama lies near the borders with Bolivia and Argentina. Dry valleys give way to salt flats, volcanic landscapes, high-altitude lakes and geysers. At night, you can observe the sky through professional telescopes.
